final: SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS site_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing')
